about: What's New in every Fanficly app: the pop-up after an update and Settings > About > What's New. Newest release first. Each release has a few short themes (an icon, a title, one line). A theme with "platforms" shows only in those apps ("apple" = iPhone, iPhone Duo, iPad and Mac; "windows"); one without shows everywhere. "icon" is an SF Symbol name the Windows app also maps (windows/src/Fanficly.App/UI/Symbols.cs). The release workflow's store notes come from the newest entry (apple/bin/release-notes.py). See changelog/README.md.

themes.title: Find in this story
themes.detail: Search the words of the story you're reading and jump straight to a match.

themes.title: Reading, your way
themes.detail: Text follows your system size and Bold Text up to 60 pt, author's notes show, and Listen picks a voice for the story's language.

themes.title: Listen in any language
themes.detail: Listen picks a voice for the story's language.

themes.title: Never miss a chapter
themes.detail: New chapters are checked while Fanficly is open, and Subscriptions lists the stories and authors you follow.

themes.title: Library and Search
themes.detail: Pick a fandom in Search's Filters, export saved stories offline, and undo a one-tap delete.

themes.title: Shared links
themes.detail: A shared AO3 link opens its story, and fanficly.app links open in an App Clip, no install needed.

themes.title: Shared links
themes.detail: A shared AO3 link opens its story, with Cancel while it loads.

themes.title: Steadier
themes.detail: Your sign-in and synced settings stay put, and error messages stay up until you close them.

themes.title: Import and export
themes.detail: Import EPUB files to read offline, and move your whole library to another device as a file.

themes.title: A calmer reader
themes.detail: The controls show and hide like Apple Books, the volume buttons can turn pages, and long one-shots open without freezing.

themes.title: Reader
themes.detail: The volume buttons can turn pages, and you can see every story in a series and go straight to the next one.

themes.title: More alerts
themes.detail: Get an alert when a new story matches a saved search, and subscribe to a story on AO3 from its options menu.

themes.title: Spotlight and Siri
themes.detail: Spotlight finds every story in your Library, and Continue Reading works with Siri, Shortcuts and the Action button.

themes.title: Fewer surprises
themes.detail: Clearer error messages, signing out really signs you out, and reading progress never goes backwards.

themes.title: Page turners
themes.detail: Turn pages with a Bluetooth page turner or scroll remote.

themes.title: Private widgets
themes.detail: Widgets hide story details while your device is locked.

themes.title: Smarter author alerts
themes.detail: An old work a followed author updates no longer shows up as new.

themes.title: Sturdier
themes.detail: Backups, restores and your settings file are more reliable, and saving no longer stalls at launch.

themes.title: Leaving full screen
themes.detail: A visible button takes you out of full screen in the reader.

themes.title: iPhone Duo
themes.detail: Fanficly fills both of the iPhone Duo's screens again, with the sidebar, two-page spreads and the fold as the gutter.

themes.title: Sync you can trust
themes.detail: Each device keeps its own reader settings, deletes stay deleted, and progress never moves backwards.

themes.title: More of your AO3
themes.detail: Marked for Later, AO3 History, kudos, and creating and editing AO3 bookmarks.

themes.title: Make it yours
themes.detail: Notes and personal tags on any saved story, your own tag and author blocklist, and a yearly reading goal.

themes.title: At a glance
themes.detail: Search results show whether you've read a story, and each story shows a reading-time estimate at your pace.

themes.title: Listen anywhere
themes.detail: Listen keeps reading in the background and on to the next chapter.

themes.title: Sized for you
themes.detail: Change the size of the whole app, and screens hold up at the largest text sizes.

themes.title: Pages fill the screen
themes.detail: Every page runs to its last line, and hiding the controls gives the page the whole screen.

themes.title: Fixes
themes.detail: The page footer stays put, and iPhone Duo's full screen and profiles work as they should.

themes.title: Read like a book
themes.detail: Two pages side by side on wide screens, with their own margins, turning two at a time.

themes.title: Made for iPhone Duo
themes.detail: Fold or unfold and you stay on the same paragraph, with the fold as the spine.

themes.title: Search, rebuilt
themes.detail: Your words go straight to AO3, with live tag suggestions and a Filters panel. Nothing is guessed.

themes.title: Sort your Library
themes.detail: By date saved, last read, last updated, title, author or length.

themes.title: Taps that land
themes.detail: Notifications and widgets open the story they're about.

themes.title: VoiceOver throughout
themes.detail: Every control is labeled, and page turns and chapter jumps are VoiceOver actions.

themes.title: Automatic iCloud sync
themes.detail: Your library merges from iCloud when the app opens, and a new device offers to re-download your stories.

themes.title: Story images
themes.detail: Show the images in stories, if you turn it on in Settings.

themes.title: Reliability
themes.detail: Fewer AO3 timeouts, safer iCloud backups, and more dependable notifications.

themes.title: Stats
themes.detail: Stories finished, time and words read, your streak, and your top fandoms, ships and authors.

themes.title: Year in Review
themes.detail: A shareable wrap-up card, made on your device.

themes.title: A fresh look
themes.detail: A new app icon and an indigo theme.

themes.title: Jump chapters while listening
themes.detail: Listen has a chapter picker and starts from your exact place.

themes.title: Popular
themes.detail: The top fandoms, ships and characters on AO3.

themes.title: Comments
themes.detail: Read each chapter's comments, and post your own when signed in.

themes.title: Followed authors and bookmarks
themes.detail: Get an alert when an author you follow posts, and browse your AO3 bookmarks.

themes.title: Now on the Mac
themes.detail: Fanficly runs on macOS, with arrow-key page turns.

themes.title: Widgets
themes.detail: Your last-read story on the Home Screen, synced across devices.

themes.title: Reader profiles
themes.detail: Save typography presets and switch between them.

themes.title: Folders
themes.detail: Organize your Library into your own folders.

themes.title: Fanficly 1.0
themes.detail: Search and browse AO3, read offline in your own style, and follow stories for new chapters. No account, ads or tracking.

themes.title: Recently Viewed
themes.detail: The stories you've opened, newest first, plus endless scrolling in Search and Browse.

themes.title: Saved filters
themes.detail: Your saved filters on the Browse home, and a cleaner reader.

themes.title: The first Fanficly
themes.detail: An open-source, ad-free AO3 reader for iPhone and iPad.
